title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 1.0189e-2 eV²
  λ_q = 0.520587
  m_eff = 2.3672e-1 eV
  T_vev = 9.8923e-2 m⁻²
  ω = 1.1515 s⁻¹
  k = 1.1424 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.992037 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -1.926e-1
  J_spin = 3.092e-1
